geeklist.title: A box of games - Ends 12/11 - CLOSED
geeklist.description:
CLOSED 9:22EST
[size=18][b]Auction is for all these games in 1 box. [/b][/size] Prices There are a mix of Hard Reserve (minimum amount that I will sell a game for), Soft Reserve (Minimum amount that I will consider selling a game for) and BIN, BIN only items (games that I will only get rid of for that price). I have the right to take items off (usually during a geekmail deal) unless it has been BIN.
If you want multiple games I do work out deals via geekmail.
BIDDING Do not bid if you do not intend to pay. I've had too many people back out. All bids must be $1 or more, and must be in whole-dollar increments. Bid by making a comment on the item you are bidding for.
Please bid with zip.
If you BIN and wish to check out I can probably get your games out to you before auction end. Just please note it in your BIN comment.
SHIPPING Shipping will be paid for by the buyer.
****Shipping to the Southwest and West coast is fairly costly****
I primarily use Pirateship for reduced rates and Shipping will most likely be done via USPS. However sometimes UPS or Fedex is cheaper and will go that route. I try to choose the cheapest. Most shipping will be medium flat rate if it fits. Saves me a box.
All shipping has tracking, and insurance (though if the item value isn't very high I may wave insurance unless requested. (paid for by winner) Shipping is US only.
I cannot be held responsible for any issues a that happens to a game on its way to you after it’s left my hands. I will pack items as best as possible.
Also upon reception you need to verify the contents in a timely manner (within a couple of days) after that if you have issues with components then I'm not sure if I can help you out.
I ship from 48152, Livonia, MI.
***It may take a week or 2 to get box for some games***
Condition I keep my games in great condition. And unless otherwise noted they are in at least very good-like new. However, The inserts of most games have been removed. As I dislike most inserts.
PAYMENT All transactions will be completed in the BGG Marketplace to provide BGG with its 3% share. All payments must be made via Paypal. Serious bidders only. Upon winning an auction, payment is due shortly thereafter. I will not hold an item until you can get money (ie "I get paid in 2 weeks can you hold it until then").
Auction Ends 12/11 sometime between 6-10p Est
geeklist.comment: I am confused, is this an auction for the 7 games in a box or for different items? You mention a reserve for items but no listed reserves
I'm still working on it. Didn't realize it would appear so quick. But it's for a box of all these game
Fyi i changed the end date to the Thursday 12/11. It works a bit better for my schedule.
